from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
import uuid, json
class Forms(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.forms=[]; self.current=None
 def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
  d=dict(attrs)
  if tag=='form': self.current=[]; self.forms.append(self.current)
  if self.current is not None and tag=='input' and d.get('name'): self.current.append((d['name'], d.get('value','')))
 def handle_endtag(self, tag):
  if tag=='form': self.current=None
base='http://localhost:3000'

forms=Forms();forms.feed(html)

finish_fields=next(form for form in forms.forms if ('id',book['id']) in form)
boundary='----bookcase'+uuid.uuid4().hex
body=b''.join((f'--{boundary}\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"{name}\"\\r\\n\\r\\n{value}\\r\\n').encode() for name,value in finish_fields)+f'--{boundary}--\\r\\n'.encode()
req=Request(base+'/books/'+book['id'],body,headers={'Content-Type':f'multipart/form-data; boundary={boundary}','Origin':base})

from html.parser import HTMLParser
from urllib.request import Request,urlopen
import uuid,json
class Forms(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__();self.forms=[];self.cur=None
 def handle_starttag(self,t,a):
  d=dict(a)
  if t=='form':self.cur=[];self.forms.append(self.cur)
  if self.cur is not None and t=='input' and d.get('name'):self.cur.append((d['name'],d.get('value','')))
 def handle_endtag(self,t):
  if t=='form':self.cur=None
base='http://localhost:3000'
def post(path,fields):
 b='----'+uuid.uuid4().hex
 body=b''.join((f'--{b}\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"{n}\"\\r\\n\\r\\n{v}\\r\\n').encode() for n,v in fields)+f'--{b}--\\r\\n'.encode()
 with urlopen(Request(base+path,body,headers={'Content-Type':f'multipart/form-data; boundary={b}','Origin':base})) as r: return r.status,r.read().decode()
p=Forms();p.feed(urlopen(base).read().decode())
fields=[x for x in p.forms[0] if x[0].startswith('"'$ACTION'"')]+[('title','A Test Book'),('author','Test Author'),('notes','An interesting note.\\nSecond line.')]
status,html=post('/',fields)
books=json.load(open('data/books.json'))
assert len(books)==1, f'expected one book, found {len(books)}; validation error {\"Please enter\" in html}'
book=books[0]
print('add:',status,book['title'],book['status'])
with urlopen(base+'/books/'+book['id']) as r: detail=r.read().decode(); print('detail:',r.status,'A Test Book' in detail,'An interesting note.' in detail)
p=Forms();p.feed(detail)
finish_fields=next(form for form in p.forms if ('id',book['id']) in form)
status,html=post('/books/'+book['id'],finish_fields)
book=json.load(open('data/books.json'))[0]
print('finish:',status,book['status'],bool(book['finishedAt']))
with urlopen(base) as r: home=r.read().decode(); print('finished shelf:', 'A Test Book' in home and 'Finished books' in home)
